title: Some terminal orders on 3-folds
summary: We produce the first known examples of non-trivial terminal local orders in the 3-dimensional case. We exhibit two different constructions. The first produces maximal orders with given toric ramification data. Since toric terminal ramification data in dimension 3 has been classified this produces toric examples. The second construction yields maximal orders ramified on surfaces with Kleinian singularities. These are automatically terminal.
